description: Deaths in large-truck crashes by who was killed (truck driver or not), for single-truck crashes, truck vs passenger-vehicle crashes and other multi-vehicle truck crashes; not a statement about fault
method: Census counts; large-truck crash = acc_aux A_LT 1; crash type from the number of motor vehicles in the crash and their veh_aux A_BODY (6 large truck, 1-5 passenger vehicle); truck driver = driver of the large-truck vehicle (victim_roles definition)
inputs: FARS person (INJ_SEV, PER_TYP, AGE, SEX, LOCATION, STR_VEH)
